definitions.explanation: A great amount or volume of something. Often used as a の-adjective to modify nouns.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}の{水|みず}が{必要|ひつよう}です。
examples.english: A large quantity of water is needed.

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}に{生産|せいさん}されている。
examples.notes: {大量|たいりょう}に = in large quantities

examples.japanese: {大量|たいりょう}{消費|しょうひ}が{問題|もんだい}になっている。
examples.english: Mass consumption has become a problem.

notes:
USAGE PATTERNS:
- {大量|たいりょう}の + Noun (a large quantity of ~)
- {大量|たいりょう}に + Verb (in large quantities, massively)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {大量|たいりょう}{生産|せいさん} (mass production)
- {大量|たいりょう}{消費|しょうひ} (mass consumption)
- {大量|たいりょう}{破壊|はかい} (mass destruction)
- {大量|たいりょう}{購入|こうにゅう} (bulk purchase)
- {大量|たいりょう}の{データ|でーた} (large amounts of data)

ANTONYM: {少量|しょうりょう} (small quantity)
